stimulus.title: A particle moving along the x-axis
stimulus.html:
The velocity of a particle, in meters per second, for 0 ≤ t ≤ 6 seconds, and its position at t = 0
QuantityValue
v(t)v(t)4cos⁡(0.9t)−0.2t4\cos(0.9t) - 0.2t meters per second, 0≤t≤60 \le t \le 6
x(0)x(0)3 meters

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Is the speed of the particle increasing or decreasing at time t=2t = 2? Give a reason for your answer.

rubric.point: Finds <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>≈</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1.309</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">v(2) \approx -1.309</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>v</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">′</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>≈</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>3.706</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a(2) = v'(2) \approx -3.706</annotation></semantics></math> (calculator).
accept: v(2) < 0 and a(2) < 0, with values or signs from the calculator

rubric.point: Increasing, because <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">v(2)</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a(2)</annotation></semantics></math> have the same sign (both negative).
accept: speeding up because velocity and acceleration are both negative

parts.sample: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">v(2)</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1.8</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>0.4</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 4\cos(1.8) - 0.4</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>≈</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1.309</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx -1.309</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>v</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">′</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>≈</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>3.706</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a(2) = v'(2) \approx -3.706</annotation></semantics></math>. Both are negative, so the speed is increasing at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t = 2</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find all times tt in 0<t<60 < t < 6 at which the particle changes direction. Justify your answer.

rubric.point: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">v(t) = 0</annotation></semantics></math> at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>≈</mo><mn>1.653</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t \approx 1.653</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>≈</mo><mn>5.548</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t \approx 5.548</annotation></semantics></math>.
accept: t = 1.653 and t = 5.548 (correct to three decimal places)

rubric.point: Justification: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">v</annotation></semantics></math> changes sign at each of these times (positive to negative at 1.653, negative to positive at 5.548).
accept: v changes sign at both times

parts.sample: Solving <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>4</mn><mi>cos</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0.9</mn><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>0.2</mn><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">4\cos(0.9t) - 0.2t = 0</annotation></semantics></math> on the calculator gives <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>≈</mo><mn>1.653</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t \approx 1.653</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>≈</mo><mn>5.548</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t \approx 5.548</annotation></semantics></math>. <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>v</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">v</annotation></semantics></math> changes from positive to negative at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>≈</mo><mn>1.653</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t \approx 1.653</annotation></semantics></math> and from negative to positive at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>≈</mo><mn>5.548</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t \approx 5.548</annotation></semantics></math>, so the particle changes direction at both times.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Find the position of the particle at time t=6t = 6.

rubric.point: Setup: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x(6)</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>6</mn></msubsup><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 3 + \int_0^6 v(t)\,dt</annotation></semantics></math>.
accept: x(0) plus the definite integral of v from 0 to 6

rubric.point: Answer: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>≈</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>4.035</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x(6) \approx -4.035</annotation></semantics></math> meters (or <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>4.034</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-4.034</annotation></semantics></math>).

parts.sample: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x(6)</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>6</mn></msubsup><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= x(0) + \int_0^6 v(t)\,dt</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>7.0345</mn><mo>…</mo><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 3 + (-7.0345\ldots)</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>≈</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>4.035</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx -4.035</annotation></semantics></math> meters.

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: Find the total distance traveled by the particle over 0≤t≤60 \le t \le 6. Find the average velocity of the particle over the same interval. Indicate units of measure.

rubric.point: Setup for distance: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>6</mn></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_0^6 |v(t)|\,dt</annotation></semantics></math>.
accept: the sum of the absolute values of the integrals of v over [0, 1.653], [1.653, 5.548] and [5.548, 6]

rubric.point: Average velocity: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>6</mn></mfrac><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>6</mn></msubsup><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{1}{6}\int_0^6 v(t)\,dt</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>≈</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1.172</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx -1.172</annotation></semantics></math> meters per second, with units.

parts.sample: Total distance <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>6</mn></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \int_0^6 |v(t)|\,dt</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>≈</mo><mn>15.974</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx 15.974</annotation></semantics></math> meters. Average velocity <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mn>6</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mfrac><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>6</mn></msubsup><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \frac{1}{6 - 0}\int_0^6 v(t)\,dt</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>≈</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>7.035</mn></mrow><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx \frac{-7.035}{6}</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>≈</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1.172</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx -1.172</annotation></semantics></math> meters per second.
